headlines.title: Vessel struck by unknown projectile in Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO says
headlines.snippet: A vessel was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday evening, causing a fire that was extinguished. The UKMTO reported that the vessel continued its voyage and all crew were safe.

headlines.title: Syria, EU discuss new agreement, recovery and Israeli withdrawal
headlines.snippet: Syria and the European Union discussed a new agreement, recovery efforts, and the demand for an Israeli withdrawal. Syria called on the EU to press for the withdrawal of Israeli forces.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia reaffirms support for Sudan’s stability, sovereignty
headlines.snippet: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman reaffirmed Saudi Arabia's commitment to Sudan's stability and sovereignty during a phone call with Abdel Fattah al-Burhan.

headlines.title: Syrian FM, EU foreign policy chief discuss ties, economic recovery and reconstruction
headlines.snippet: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad Hassan al-Shaibani met with EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas to discuss bilateral relations, regional developments, and efforts to support stability and economic recovery in Syria.

headlines.title: Syria allows non-exclusive agencies for foreign vehicle and tire firms
headlines.snippet: Syria will permit foreign vehicle, machinery, and tire companies to register non-exclusive agencies and open branches. Companies must register with the relevant department at the Ministry of Economy and Industry.

headlines.title: Syria’s Muslim Brotherhood fights for its future
headlines.snippet: Syria's Muslim Brotherhood is reportedly weighing its political future amidst regional pressure and internal divisions, with questions arising about political parties and pluralism during Syria's uncertain transition.

headlines.title: Syria is rising, al-Sharaa tells UN—but challenges remain at home
headlines.snippet: Syria is described as "rising" by al-Sharaa at the UN, but domestic challenges remain. The focus is on transforming international acceptance into economic progress and stronger institutions.

headlines.title: UAE says FlyDubai co-pilot attempted to carry out terrorist attack
headlines.snippet: The UAE stated that the Flydubai co-pilot attempted to carry out a terrorist attack. This statement was made by an official from the UAE.

headlines.title: Gargash says FlyDubai attack ‘terrorist act’ as he praises pilot
headlines.snippet: Gargash stated that the Flydubai attack was a "terrorist act" and praised the pilot's actions. The incident is under investigation.

headlines.title: Tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz: UK maritime agency
headlines.snippet: A tanker was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, according to the UK maritime agency. The incident is being investigated.

headlines.title: Indian FlyDubai pilot Smit Machchhar praised for bravery during cockpit attack
headlines.snippet: Indian Flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar has been praised for his bravery during a cockpit attack. He was airlifted to the UAE.

headlines.title: Two Iranians charged with planning attack on Manchester Jews
headlines.snippet: Two Iranians have been charged with planning an attack on Jewish people in Manchester. The details of the alleged plot are under investigation.

headlines.title: Oil tankers attacked in Hormuz strait: UK maritime agency
headlines.snippet: Oil tankers were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, as reported by the UK maritime agency. The circumstances surrounding the attacks are being investigated.

headlines.title: Houthi drone hits Medina power station supplying Prophet’s Mosque
headlines.snippet: A Houthi drone hit a power station in Medina that supplies the Prophet's Mosque. The extent of the damage and potential casualties are being assessed.

headlines.title: Hero flydubai pilot Capt. Smit Machchhar airlifted to UAE; Indian Ambassador visits him
headlines.snippet: Heroic Flydubai pilot Capt. Smit Machchhar has been airlifted to the UAE, and the Indian Ambassador visited him. He is recovering from injuries sustained during the incident.

headlines.title: UAE orders investigation into flydubai Tel Aviv flight incident
headlines.snippet: The UAE has ordered an investigation into the Flydubai flight incident involving a flight to Tel Aviv. The airline is cooperating with the authorities.

headlines.title: flydubai CEO thanks captain Machchhar Smit, crew and passengers after flight safety incident
headlines.snippet: The CEO of Flydubai thanked Captain Machchhar Smit, the crew, and passengers following the flight safety incident. He commended their handling of the situation.

headlines.title: UAE says co-pilot attempted ‘terrorist act’ in Flydubai incident
headlines.snippet: The UAE stated that the co-pilot attempted a "terrorist act" in the Flydubai incident. Hamad Saif al-Shamsi added that an investigation is underway to uncover all circumstances.

headlines.title: Israeli forces arrest 4 Palestinians, search homes in West Bank raids
headlines.snippet: Israeli forces arrested six Palestinians from the West Bank and are holding approximately 9,350 Palestinians, including women and children. These figures are according to Palestinian sources.

headlines.title: Yemeni army carries out 71 operations against Houthi positions in country's southwest
headlines.snippet: The Yemeni army claims to have launched six air strikes targeting Houthi positions in Taiz. The operations were reportedly focused on Houthi gatherings and reinforcements.

headlines.title: 1st Israeli flight departs Dubai to repatriate stranded passengers after Flydubai incident
headlines.snippet: The first Israeli flight has departed Dubai to repatriate stranded passengers following the Flydubai incident. This comes after temporary suspension of Flydubai flights.

headlines.title: ‘I was not going to let others die’: Flydubai pilot recounts cockpit attack
headlines.snippet: Flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar recounted the cockpit attack, stating he forced the cockpit door open despite injuries as the plane carrying over 170 passengers plunged 17,000 feet. He stated, "I was not going to let others die."

headlines.title: King Charles to confront Britain’s slavery past during Caribbean tour
headlines.snippet: King Charles is set to confront Britain's "darkest days" concerning its past slavery during a Caribbean tour. This comes amid renewed calls for Britain to address its history.

headlines.title: Egypt's Sisi calls for peaceful solutions to Africa’s conflicts
headlines.snippet: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi urged African nations to prioritize peaceful conflict resolution, strengthen state institutions, and respect national sovereignty.

headlines.title: Philippines urges ASEAN talks after 50 killed in Myanmar airstrike
headlines.snippet: The Philippines, holding the 2026 ASEAN chairmanship, has urged talks after a deadly airstrike in Myanmar's Rakhine state killed 50 people. The Philippines expressed concern over the incident.

headlines.title: Christa Pike unconscious as Tennessee execution goes awry: Lawyers
headlines.snippet: Convicted killer Christa Pike was left unconscious and on life support after Tennessee's botched execution attempt by lethal injection, her lawyers reported.

headlines.title: India detains hundreds as voter-roll protests erupt in Delhi
headlines.snippet: Hundreds of protesters were detained in New Delhi during demonstrations against India's chief election commissioner. Youth groups and opposition parties are demanding reforms.

headlines.title: PHOTO Best restaurants in Istanbul, ranked
headlines.snippet: The "Pearly Gastronomy Guide" by Hürriyet newspaper ranks Istanbul's top 20 restaurants. This guide was created by a jury of experts.

headlines.snippet: Türkiye, historically home to civilizations like the Roman and Ottoman empires, boasts some of the world's best museums. The guide features the top 20 museums.

headlines.title: FlyDubai co-pilot attacked captain with 'axe' in 'terrorist' attempt, UAE top prosecutor says
headlines.snippet: The UAE's top prosecutor stated that the Flydubai co-pilot attacked the captain with an "axe" in an attempted "terrorist" act. An investigation is ongoing to uncover all circumstances.

headlines.title: Trump says co-pilot in flydubai incident may have been a 'terrorist' or 'whack-job'
headlines.snippet: President Trump suggested that the co-pilot involved in the Flydubai incident may have been a "terrorist" or a "whack-job." He commented on the potential motives.

headlines.title: Arab party leader agrees to drop out of Israeli election race under court pressure
headlines.snippet: An Arab party leader has agreed to withdraw from the Israeli election race under court pressure. The decision follows legal scrutiny.

headlines.title: US is moving around 9,000 troops aboard ships to Middle East as Trump weighs new attacks on Iran
headlines.snippet: The US is moving approximately 9,000 troops aboard ships to the Middle East. This deployment occurs as President Trump considers new attacks on Iran.

headlines.title: Yemeni army says it launched six air strikes on Houthi positions in Taiz
headlines.snippet: The Yemeni army announced it launched six air strikes targeting Houthi positions in Taiz. The army spokesman detailed the nature of the targeted Houthi sites.
